summary: Schedule with microsecond-precision offsets launches only once instead of repeatedly according to the interval specification. The issue appears to stem from truncation of the microsecond component during validation or persistence.
userImpact: Users who define schedule offsets with microsecond precision experience schedules launching only once instead of repeatedly according to the specified interval.
rootCause: The offset is being truncated to second-resolution somewhere in the validation or persistence path before the interval calculator processes it, causing subsequent fire timestamps to never align with the interval.
proposedFix: Add explicit precision contract for ScheduleIntervalSpec.offset documenting supported resolutions, and either reject sub-second offsets loudly or support them end-to-end without silent truncation.
keyQuote: somewhere on the validation/persistence path the offset is being downcast to second-resolution before the interval calculator sees it
